incident-bot: ALERT: Spike detected — eu-west economy tier 95p latency >1200ms across /v1/generate, error-rate creeping 4.3%. Auto-pager: oncall
Marta (oncall): I'm on it. Paging @Raj and @Chen. Starting triage in #incidents.
Marta (oncall): quick context — traffic suddenly shifted to economy nodes in eu-west after an upstream capacity blip; premium nodes are healthy but steering rules not favoring them due to recent weight changes.
Raj (eng-sre): ack. Can you drop the recent steering patch and shift some weight off eu-west-economy? I want to avoid broad throttles if we can steer.
Chen (platform): looking at routing config now. I see a recent canary that bumped economy weight in eu-west-primary to 0.9 at 07:58 UTC (human roll).
Alice (eng-runtime): that canary also enabled precise-context-sync for econ which increases KV pressure — could be compounding. Suggest disabling that flag for economy in eu-west temporarily.
Marta (oncall): status: customers affected = partial impact for 4 customers (ACME, BetaApps, Tutorly, Weatherly). Latency P95 for ACME endpoints ~1500ms, timeouts for some requests. No complete outages reported.
Sam (support): I'm drafting an external message for impacted customers, will post once we have mitigation plan.
Raj (eng-sre): plan — 1) apply regional steer to reduce traffic to eu-west-econ by 60% to alternative pools (eu-central & eu-west-2), 2) disable precise-context-sync for economy in eu-west, 3) apply soft per-customer TPS dampening for the top 10 heavy customers in the last 15m. Rollout as short TTL (15m) and monitor.
Chen (platform): preparing routing patch. Dropping dry-run flag once verified.
Chen (platform): PATCH (temp steer) — pushing now:
```json
{
  "policy": "regional_steer_temp",
  "match": { "region": "eu-west", "tier": "economy", "path": "/v1/generate" },
  "action": { "steer_to": ["eu-central-1","eu-west-2"], "weights": [0.6,0.4] },
  "ttl_seconds": 900,
  "created_by": "platform@redwood"
}
```
Chen (platform): applying with infractl: `infractl routing apply --file /tmp/eu-west-steer.json --env=prod`
OpsHero (deploy-bot): deploy started for routing change eu-west steer (id: deploy-7743). Checkpoint logs forwarded.
Chen (platform): deploy completed, status=applied.
Marta (oncall): disabling precise-context-sync flag for economy in eu-west now. Command: `featurectl toggle precise-context-sync --env=prod --region=eu-west --tier=economy --off`
Alice (eng-runtime): confirmed flag off, runtime logs show KV cache write rate down ~32%.
Raj (eng-sre): applying soft TPS caps for top customers — using admin API. Example: `POST /admin/limits` body: 
```
customer: "acme-corp"
limit_tps: 30
window_secs: 60
mode: "soft"
```
Raj (eng-sre): caps applied to top 8 noisy customers. Noted: soft mode => 429s with Retry-After header; support notified.
Sam (support): external status update draft posted to status.redwood: "We are mitigating increased latency in EU-West for some customers by routing traffic and applying temporary rate controls; some requests may receive 429s with Retry-After. Investigating root cause; will update in 15m."
Marta (oncall): monitoring: P95 dropped from 1500ms -> 760ms over 3 minutes, error-rate down to 1.2%. Good signal.
Alice (eng-runtime): memory/KV pressure on eu-west-econ nodes decreasing. Thread-level telemetry shows reduced queue length.
Raj (eng-sre): adding short-term guard: if P95 >1000ms after 10m, escalate to Tier 2 and consider disabling economy lane entirely for eu-west until we find root cause.
Chen (platform): logged a ticket to roll back the human canary that bumped weights (change-id: chg-2026-842).
Marta (oncall): handing off to Raj for monitoring and follow-up duty (next 60 mins). I'm going offline to coordinate customer comms. Raj — you're primary.
Raj (eng-sre): taking handoff. I'll keep this thread as the single-source channel for mitigation updates.
Sam (support): will follow up with impacted customers (ACME, BetaApps, Tutorly, Weatherly) with the temp mitigation and expected next update in 30m.
Alice (eng-runtime): follow-ups for postmortem: - evaluate precise-context-sync KV footprint, - add canary safety check to prevent full-weight canaries, - add automatic steer fallback when node latency crosses threshold.
Chen (platform): done. I'll create a post-incident change plan and link to this thread.
OpsHero (deploy-bot): routing revert window opened (ttl will expire at +15m if no action).
Raj (eng-sre): noted. If metrics remain stable, we'll let steer TTL expire and then roll a safe canary undo for the human change with smaller weight steps.
Marta (oncall): thanks team. Logging final notes here then closing page: mitigations applied = steer+flag-off+soft-caps. Impact summary to include in postmortem: partial latency degrade for EU-West economy; customer-visible timeouts/429s for top noisy customers.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity reduced to P2 (was P1) at 2109876625. Primary mitigations applied.
Raj (eng-sre): closing handoff note — I'll post a 30m check-in and a 4-hour follow-up with root-cause hypothesis.
Sam (support): acknowledged.
Marta (oncall): closing my loop. Good work everyone :thumbsup:
